'''Sergio Domenech''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 49 FL from Madrid, Sp. The published fan table marks the slot Retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

== Squadron listing ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Slot !! Town !! Status (fan table)
|-
| Red 49 FL || Madrid, Sp || Retired
|}

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support). "FL" is printed on some slots in the surviving tables; the tables do not spell out the abbreviation.

== Spanish Two-Player rules booklet ==

On 8 September 2021 he posted a 20-page Spanish-language scan of a Decipher [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] rules booklet to the Star Wars CCG Facebook group. That scan is the surviving printer proof on [[Spanish Premiere Two-Player Game rules booklet]].<ref name="fb-sergio">[https://www.facebook.com/groups/starwarsccg/permalink/10159018539903127/ SWCCG Two-Player Game Rulesbook (Spanish).pdf], Sergio Domenech, Star Wars CCG Facebook group (8 September 2021). Preserved copy: [https://archive.org/details/swccg-spanish-2pg-rules-booklet-1998 Internet Archive]; [[:File:Spanish_Premiere_Two-Player_Game_rules_booklet.pdf]].</ref>
